bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Huang says chip sales to double next year; remains bullish despite AI safety debate
bullets.body: NVDA CEO Jensen Huang publicly dismissed AI development slowdown concerns at multiple venues (All-In Summit, TMT conferences), affirming demand will outpace supply across almost every semiconductor product area for the next several quarters. He stated chip unit sales will roughly double next year, and characterized AI safety concerns as manageable through engineering rather than slowing development. Multiple broker checks (Jefferies, JPM, Citi) confirmed management meetings showed intact capex orders despite Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's September 12 call to pace frontier model development.

bullets.title: MU: Memory prices surge 5-7x; shortage worsening into 2027 with $100B take-or-pay contracts
bullets.body: Intel CEO flagged memory prices have jumped 5-7x and now comprise ~75% of cost for lower-end phones and laptops. SK Hynix warned 2027 may be the worst supply year. Separately, RBC channel checks project 80-100% HBM ASP hikes for 2027. Micron demonstrated the world's first 512GB DDR5 module with volume production targeted for H2 2027. JPM noted MU has $100B in take-or-pay contracts providing revenue visibility.

bullets.title: META: Muse AI agent hits #1 on US Apple App Store; subscription tiers launched; Connect 9/23-24 catalyst
bullets.body: META's Muse personal AI agent reached #1 on the US Apple App Store within days of launch, outranking ChatGPT, with 900K+ downloads in the first week. META simultaneously launched Meta One subscription service with tiers from $2.99/month to $499/month for enterprise. Citi added META to 90-day upside catalyst watch ahead of Meta Connect on 9/23-24. Morgan Stanley estimates 100M Muse users could add +1% to 2028 EPS, with +15% upside potential if transaction monetization materializes.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone 18 Pro Week 1 lead times resilient; Duo foldable launch; M8 Ultra server plans surface
bullets.body: Citi's Innovation Lab tracked iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max Week 1 delivery data showing resilient demand—times slightly higher in US/UK vs. prior year, consistent in India, shorter in China (~4-5 week waits). iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max officially launched on Sept 18. Separately, The Information reported Apple is evaluating M8 Ultra-based enterprise AI servers with NVDA NVLink for a potential 2029-or-later launch, which would be positive for server OEM demand.

bullets.title: NFLX: Wells Fargo downgrades to Underweight, slashes PT to $57 on engagement and content concerns
bullets.body: Wells Fargo downgraded NFLX to Underweight from Equal Weight and cut the price target to $57 from $80, citing weakening hours-per-subscriber trends (expected to decline y/y in H2 2026), a weaker original content slate, and elevated churn risk in 2027. The stock fell ~4.4% pre-market on the news. Analyst Steven Cahall is the downgrading analyst.

bullets.title: CRM: Dreamforce 2026 and investor day reinforce FY30 $63B target; AIforce, Claudeforce, Koa model launch
bullets.body: Salesforce unveiled AIforce at Dreamforce—a headless interface layer integrating enterprise data with Claude, Slack, and Agentforce Coworker—and launched Koa, a CRM reasoning model built on NVIDIA Nemotron. Management reaffirmed FY30 revenue target of $63B+ and highlighted premium edition (Max at $550/user/month) as repricing catalyst. JPM maintains Overweight with $265 PT; BMO raised PT to $285; Citi raised PT to $263 (Neutral). Key debate remains timing of organic revenue re-acceleration in 2H FY27.

bullets.title: INTC: SK Hynix memory chip deal talks lift stock; 14A process evaluated by major hyperscalers
bullets.body: Reuters reported SK Hynix is in exploratory talks with Intel about leasing part of the Ohio facility or forming a JV to manufacture memory chips in the US for the first time. INTC rose 4-10% on the news, with MU also moving higher in sympathy. Separately, Intel's 14A process is reportedly being evaluated by Amazon, Apple, AMD, Google, Tesla, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Qualcomm as a potential manufacturing partner.

bullets.title: AMD: GPU price hike ~10% in Q4 on TSMC cost pass-through; whale options position +50% in 3 days
bullets.body: AMD is reportedly planning a ~10% price hike on GPUs, AI chips, and chipsets in Q4 2026 due to rising TSMC costs. Pre-quiet period call confirmed Helios and Venice CPU ramps on track, with datacenter business expected to more than double in CY27. Separately, a whale's $1.3M AMD call position at the $1,000 strike (while stock traded ~$500) gained +50% in 3 days with zero drawdown, reflecting bullish options activity.

bullets.title: TSM: CoWoS capacity raised 4-6% through 2028; sub-1.4nm fab approvals secured; demand-supply gap narrows to 10%
bullets.body: JPM raised TSMC CoWoS capacity estimates to 200K/225K wfpm by end 2027/28 with demand-supply gap narrowing to ~10%. Leading-edge wafers and substrates are now the bigger bottlenecks. TSMC separately secured approval for sub-1.4nm manufacturing plants, with first fab targeted for mass production by 2030 and investment exceeding NT$1 trillion (~$31.4B). NVDA's Feynman chip will adopt 3D SoIC logic-logic stacking in 2028.

bullets.title: TSEM: Barclays initiates Buy at $310, 41% upside; MTSI upgraded to Buy at BMO with $335 PT
bullets.body: Barclays initiated Tower Semiconductor (TSEM) at Overweight with a $310 price target (~41% upside), citing the firm's well-placed position in silicon photonics and near-packaged optics for data center expansion in 2027. TSEM also began high-volume shipments of laser-integrated optical engines with NewPhotonics using its PH18DA SiPho platform for 800G/1.6T standards. Separately, BMO upgraded MACOM (MTSI) to Buy at $335 PT on 60% annual EPS growth and diversification into aerospace/defense and satellite.

bullets.title: HUBS: Analyst Day raises FY30 EBIT margin target to 30%; AI adoption driving seats-and-credits shift
bullets.body: HubSpot's 2026 Analyst Day reinforced AI moat with Breeze Assistant adoption at 57% of Pro+ customers (up from 37% at year-start) and monthly credit consumption doubling. The company raised its FY30 non-GAAP operating margin target to 30% from 25% prior. No mid-term revenue growth guidance was provided, keeping the stock 'show me' for re-rating. JPM raised PT to $268 (Overweight); UBS raised PT to $290 (Buy); Mizuho maintains Outperform at $260.

bullets.title: INTU: Investor Day reaffirms FY27 guidance; Big Bets growing 30%+; valuation at historical lows
bullets.body: Intuit's Investor Day framed FY27 as a deliberate reset focused on customer growth while Big Bets (Assisted Tax, Money, Mid-Market) each exceed $1B in revenue and grow 30%+. FY27 and Q1 guidance were reaffirmed unchanged. INTU trades at 12.5x CY27 P/E vs. a 30x 5-year average. KeyBanc maintains Overweight at $400 PT; Mizuho rates Outperform at $430 PT; Wolfe rates Peer Perform; Truist has a $300 Hold with a 'show me' posture.

bullets.title: DKNG: Wells Fargo cuts PT to $48 from $49; NY GGR down 76% on hold compression; sportsbook headwinds persist
bullets.body: DraftKings reported NY sports betting GGR down 76% y/y for week ending Sept 13 as hold rates compressed to 2.2% from 10.0% y/y. NFL Week 1 saw public favorites win at elevated rates (67% ML, up from 63%) and total TDs surge ~34% y/y, creating headwinds for sportsbooks industry-wide. UBS lowered FY26 revenue by 1% and EBITDA by 5%, maintaining a Buy rating. The prediction market SCOTUS case—expected for spring 2027 oral arguments—remains an important wild card.

bullets.title: CLS: CFO transition drives 7-8% selloff; single-sourced for OpenAI Gen 1 rack with multi-billion AMD ramp in 2027
bullets.body: Celestica shares dropped 7-8% after the company announced its CFO is transitioning to Group President, with a new CFO appointed effective October 1. The selloff was viewed as overdone given fundamentals: CLS is single-sourced for the first generation of OpenAI's rack program, has multiple billions in AMD scale-up switch contribution in 2027, and is positioned as a potential Anthropic custom ASIC program contender. JPM maintains Overweight; $3B equity raise was needed for working capital, not additional dilution.

bullets.title: CIEN: FY29 targets set at 30% revenue CAGR and 50% gross margins; $450 PT at Morgan Stanley
bullets.body: Ciena announced ambitious FY29 financial targets: ~30% revenue CAGR from 2026-2029, adjusted gross margins of ~50%, and operating margins of 32-35%. Supply constraints (pump lasers from LITE/COHR) remain gating factors through 2028. Morgan Stanley raised the PT to $450 noting continued share gains and a multi-year earnings estimate above Street. JPM maintains Overweight; Citi maintains Neutral (Equal-Weight) with PT raised to $350 on confidence in growth framework.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Waymo Singapore 2028 launch; large call prints; Blackstone/Google Crux AI JV secures $22-23B financing
bullets.body: Waymo (Alphabet subsidiary) announced a commercial robotaxi launch in Singapore in 2028, beginning mapping in early 2027. Blackstone finalized $22-23B in financing from 10 banks for its AI infrastructure JV with Google (Crux AI), with first 500 MW capacity expected online in 2027. Separately, unusual millions in GOOGL call options were printed intraday, and Goldman Sachs characterized GOOGL as 'too cheap' ahead of an expected Gemini 4 release by year-end.

bullets.title: HOOD: SEC tokenization order positive; cash APY raised to 3.6%; prediction market legal risk remains
bullets.body: Robinhood raised cash APY on brokerage accounts to 3.6%. The SEC issued a 5-year innovation exemption for tokenized US equities on blockchain, which is a structural positive for HOOD's crypto and tokenization roadmap. However, the failure of the CLARITY Act to clear Senate cloture creates uncertainty for crypto-related revenue, and the company faces potential impact from SCOTUS ruling on prediction market sports bets, which analysts estimate could come by mid-to-late 2027.

bullets.title: GNRC: +30% on $2.4-8B Amazon data center generator supply deal with warrant issuance
bullets.body: Generac shares surged ~30-33% after announcing a supply agreement with Amazon for backup power generators for data centers—with contracted value of $2.4B and potential upside to $8B total. Amazon received a warrant to acquire up to 1.693M GNRC shares at $200.93. Citi noted Weichai Power (the engine supplier) could see ~$441M in contribution. The deal validates continued AI infrastructure buildout capex and is structurally bullish for data center power providers.

bullets.title: WBD/PSKY: FCC approves foreign ownership waiver for planned Paramount-Skydance/WBD deal
bullets.body: The FCC waived rules to allow foreign wealth funds up to 49.5% ownership in the planned PSKY-WBD combination. Additionally, a federal judge set October 14-15 as the date for antitrust settlement talks between PSKY/WBD and 12 state attorneys general. PSKY was initiated at Citizens with Outperform and $14 PT, while WBD was reinstated at Barclays with Equal Weight and $29 PT.

bullets.title: T (AT&T): JPM top pick; raises fiber net add estimate to 390K for Q3; maintains $33 Dec-27 PT
bullets.body: JPMorgan raised AT&T's Q3 fiber net add estimate to 390K from 375K, driven by accelerating convergence momentum. Management characterized Q2 as a 'tipping point.' AT&T remains JPM's top pick in telecom on its Focus List with a $33 December 2027 PT—implying 30%+ upside—based on 4% EBITDA CAGR and 13% FCF/share CAGR through 2028, with >$45B in planned capital returns.
